name: The Bangala
signature_dish: Chettinad banana-leaf spread — pepper chicken, uppu kari, crab curry, tomato rice
why_it_matters: Established 1999 as the first heritage hotel in Chettinad, on family property held for over a century — The Bangala is the most renowned address for authentic Chettinad cuisine, with recipes handed down through generations and spices ground on stone. The lavish banana-leaf spread (pepper chicken, uppu kari, tamarind crab) is widely cited as the definitive Chettinad meal.
insider_tip: Reserve well ahead — meals are served as a fixed multi-course banana-leaf spread at set times, not à la carte. This is the benchmark Chettinad dining experience; come hungry. Karaikudi is the central town of the region. Cards + cash.
signature_address: Devakottai Road, Senjai, Karaikudi, Sivaganga District, Tamil Nadu 630001

name: Visalam (CGH Earth)
signature_dish: South Indian Chettinad cuisine served on a plantain leaf in a restored mansion
why_it_matters: The restaurant at Visalam, CGH Earth's heritage hotel in a century-old Chettiar mansion in Kanadukathan village — built by KVAL Ramanathan Chettiar for his daughter Visalakshi. Its Shapad Shala dining hall serves Chettinad cuisine on plantain leaves, with interactive cooking experiences, in one of the finest restored mansions of the region.
insider_tip: Call ahead — this is a resort restaurant in a heritage mansion, and non-residents should reserve. Kanadukathan is the heart of Chettinad's mansion country, so combine the meal with a mansion walk. Cards + cash.
signature_address: Visalam, CGH Earth, Local Road, Kanadukathan, Sivaganga District, Tamil Nadu 630103

name: Sri Priya Mess
signature_dish: Chettinad non-veg mess plate — chicken, mutton, fish, crab on rice
why_it_matters: Started in 1968 near Koppudaiamman Koil in Karaikudi and still family-run — Sri Priya Mess is the homely non-veg Chettinad mess locals send people to for authentic, no-frills cooking. There is no vegetarian lunch: you pick a non-veg dish (chicken, mutton, fish, crab, or the offal specialities) and it comes with rice. The real working-Chettinad meal.
insider_tip: Order a non-veg dish to go with rice — there is no veg option here. The mutton offal fries and savuroti are the dishes the regulars come for. Crowded and basic; that is the authenticity. Come at lunch. Cash + UPI.
signature_address: Near Koppudaiamman Koil, Karaikudi, Sivaganga District, Tamil Nadu 630001

name: 86 Pillars (The Lotus Palace Chettinad)
signature_dish: Chettinad thali built on heirloom recipes
why_it_matters: The fine-dining restaurant of The Lotus Palace Chettinad, a heritage boutique hotel in Karaikudi run by The Park hotels group — its 86 Pillars restaurant serves Chettinad thalis built on heirloom recipes in a courtyard of carved wooden pillars. A polished, comfortable way to taste the region's cuisine.
insider_tip: Order the Chettinad thali for the full spice-driven spread in a hotel-grade setting. A good choice if you want Chettinad cuisine with air-conditioned comfort and a bar nearby. Cards + cash.
signature_address: The Lotus Palace Chettinad, Karaikudi, Sivaganga District, Tamil Nadu 630001

name: Chettinad Court, Kanadukathan
signature_dish: Authentic Chettinad cuisine at value prices
why_it_matters: A value-for-money Chettinad restaurant in Kanadukathan, very close to National Highway 210 — Chettinad Court serves authentic Chettinad cuisine at mid-range prices, a practical sit-down option for travellers touring the mansion villages who do not want a full heritage-hotel meal.
insider_tip: The accessible everyday alternative to the heritage-hotel restaurants — authentic Chettinad food without the fine-dining price. Handy off NH-210 while doing the mansion circuit. Cash + cards.
signature_address: Kanadukathan, near NH-210, Karaikudi Taluk, Sivaganga District, Tamil Nadu 630103
